version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: LUFS Calibration System: Create/update profiles from reference tracks Per-profile LUFS measurement settings (segment size, percentile, threshold) Normalization resets Item Gain and Take Volume before processing Fixed mode switching: tracks reload when toggling Import/Normalize

version.changelog: Fixed ReaPack metadata for package distribution LUFS Calibration System: Create/update profiles from reference tracks Per-profile LUFS measurement settings (segment size, percentile, threshold) Normalization resets Item Gain and Take Volume before processing Fixed mode switching: tracks reload when toggling Import/Normalize

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Multi-RPP Import: import multiple RPP files into one template Merged tempo/time-signatures with full API fidelity (no project reload) Time-based offset system (seconds) for all positioning Track consolidation with lane alignment and group flag copying Column-based mapping UI with per-RPP dropdowns and drag-drop reordering Editable template track names in both single and multi-RPP mode

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Drag & drop .rpp and audio files from OS file manager onto window Auto-classification: .rpp files go to import, audio files added as sources Multiple .rpp files auto-switch to Multi-RPP mode Visual hover feedback (accent border) during drag Auto-matching triggers after import/drop (both single and multi-RPP) Fixed: multi-RPP auto-matching after import (was calling single-RPP matcher)

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Live Template Sync: auto-detect template track changes (add/remove/rename) Smart rebuild preserves all existing mappings via name-based matching Throttled fingerprint check (~2x/sec) with near-zero performance cost Multi-RPP UI: removed redundant Match All from table, toolbar buttons now mode-aware Multi-RPP: lock drag-to-paint and header toggle-all (matching single-RPP behavior) Fixed: drag-state reset was only running in single-RPP scope

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Single-RPP: "Import Markers/Tempomap" checkbox (auto-imports on commit) Fixed: nameless regions from source RPP not imported (pairing assumed non-empty names) Fixed: multi-RPP track automation only imported from first RPP (chunk-based envelope merge) Envelope merge rewritten: collected from prepared chunks, applied as final write after all API ops

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Sel column in Normalize-only mode (multi-select, drag-to-paint, Shift-range) "Set all to" bulk action bar in all modes (applies to selected or all) "Calibrate" button in header when Normalize is active Multi-select profile/peak changes apply to all selected rows Settings: UI + Save/Load merged into "General" tab Consistent footer layout across all modes Keep Name / Keep FX columns narrower Removed Little Joe profile sync

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Fixed Windows multi-file audio import: bare filenames now joined with their directory (no more "audio files not found") Fixed destructive commit: a missing audio file no longer deletes its template track Commit now runs an atomic pre-flight — aborts and touches nothing if any mapped audio file is missing

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Single-RPP "Import Markers/Tempomap": tempo applied BEFORE item import so beat-locked items stay on the grid Fixed items deleted / tracks appearing empty after import (SetTempoTimeSigMarker arg order + apply order) Lane-safe "Delete gaps between regions": no longer wipes the whole comp lane on comped multi-lane tracks Markers/regions created before normalization; source-RPP region count shown pre-commit

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Windows: libusb + hidapi now live in UserPlugins alongside reaper_rea-sixty.dll (delay-load + AddDllDirectory). No more manual placement next to reaper.exe. Linux: udev rule installer button in Settings -> About (one pkexec prompt, same UX as the Windows WinUSB-installer). ReaPack support for all three platforms.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Device pane: three new toggles under Settings -> Device -- TCP follows UF8 selection, Show tracks hidden in TCP, Show tracks hidden in MCP (mirror REAPER's panel visibility), and Don't show offline FX (skipped by every cycle ring + the UF8 colour-bar default cursor).
SEL-Mode polish: leaving Auto SEL mode now scrolls the UF8 bank so the selected track is in view again, mirrored on Selection Set deactivation. Auto exit also reverts selset auto-arming back to Trim/Read when the Selection-Set auto-mode dropdown is engaged.
Selset activation snaps the bank to the first channel of the set so larger sets start at strip 0.
Bug fix: FX/Instance Cycle dispatch swap in reasixty_dispatchSelModeCycle. With "UF8 Ch. Encoder drives Sel-Mode cycle" enabled, Instance Cycle was routing to the FX-Cycle handler and vice versa.
UF8 colour-bar follows the Channel-Encoder FX Cycle cursor through ReaEQ, ReaComp, etc. -- previously stayed pinned to the focused-domain Instance label on non-Instance landings.
UC1 carousel now shows the lone plug-in name when only one cycle target exists (or only one online target with hide-offline enabled).
Settings reorganisation: every Device control lives in the sidebar Device pane. The orphan "Device" sub-tab under Modes is gone -- its two checkboxes moved to the main Device pane. UC1 GR calibration relocated to the very bottom.
User-renamed FX instances now win over hardcoded displayShort everywhere -- primarily SSL 360 Link, where the "Link" / "L-BC" abbreviation hid what the wrapped plug-in actually was.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Track-name abbreviation modes -- Settings -> Device -> Tracks adds a "Long track-name handling" combo. Default Truncate keeps the legacy 7-char cut. Smart abbreviate drops separators, then vowels after the first letter of each token, then collapses repeated consonants, then distributes the remaining char budget proportionally across tokens (short all-caps tokens like DI / FX / EQ survive). "Background Vocals" -> "BckgVcl", "Drums Bus" -> "DrmsBs". Mode switch repaints all 8 strips immediately.
Reverse LED per Solo / Cut / Sel binding (FX Learn editor right-click) -- for plug-ins whose Cut/Bypass param reports 1 = inactive. Render layer XORs the LED on/off bit. Persisted per (fader-bank, strip, button).
Plugin Mode + This-Track Sends/Receives now keep all 8 strips addressable even when fewer than 8 REAPER tracks are visible. Strips past the bank-track count source content from the focused FX (PM) or route target (sends) instead of going blank.
Fill sequential (right) in the FX Learn editor carries source-strip attributes onto every filled strip: faderInverted, V-Pot inverted/vpotMode/defaultNorm/stripColour, and Solo / Cut / Sel colour + Reverse LED flag. A CS-row fill no longer needs per-strip touch-ups.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Appearance tab (Settings -> Appearance): Dark / Light theme picker plus Small / Medium / Large font-size picker. Re-themes every Settings panel + the FX Learn schematic; hardware-face colours stay constant.
Keyboard Cmd / Ctrl as Shift-style modifiers (Settings -> Modes -> Keyboard Options) — three independent checkboxes that promote the host keyboard's Shift / Cmd / Ctrl into the same Plain / Shift / Cmd / Ctrl modifier slots the UF8 modifier keys feed.
Wrap Plugin Cycle toggle (Settings -> Device -> Plug-ins). Default on. When off, both ends of the FX chain hard-stop on every cycle path (Channel-Encoder FX/Instance Cycle, per-strip V-Pot FX/Instance Cycle) and the UC1 carousel shows no neighbour name past the first/last FX.
Hide tracks in collapsed folders (Settings -> Device -> Tracks). Independent surface-side mirror of REAPER's hide-children-of-collapsed-folders preference -- when on, any track whose ancestor folder is fully collapsed (I_FOLDERCOMPACT == 2) drops from the UF8 strip list. Default off; follows live folder-state changes.
UC1 Encoder 2 push actions unified -- Plain / Shift / Long-press all pick from the same 7-option enum (Jump+Drill, Jump only, Drill only, Back, Toggle View, Add marker at playhead, Disabled) via dropdown. View-locks now suppress Drill only; other actions fire regardless. Defaults match prior behaviour (Plain=Jump+Drill, Shift=Drill, Long=Back); any custom Shift / Long config is reset on upgrade since the old 0/1/2 stored values mapped to different actions.
Settings layout pass -- Selection Sets + Parameter Groups rebuilt as fixed-width tables; UF8 / UC1 mockup labels locked to 10 px and centred over button blocks; LED override colour swatch + brightness radios moved inline next to the Override Active / Inactive checkboxes; Nav-cross down arrow aligned with FOOT 1/2 bottom; pagination hints on Nav-Mode strips 0/7 removed.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
TCP / MCP follow radio (Settings -> Device -> Tracks "Surface mirrors:") replaces the three v0.1.4 visibility checkboxes (Show TCP hidden / Show MCP hidden / Hide tracks in collapsed folders). The new model defers to REAPER's IsTrackVisible(track, mixer), which folds per-track B_SHOWIN* AND ancestor folder-collapse state into one call. TCP mode (default) hides children of collapsed folders whenever REAPER's "Hide children of collapsed folders" preference is on; MCP mode mirrors the mixer's visibility. Existing v0.1.4 ExtState migrates automatically.
Channel encoders now respect the visibility filter. The v0.1.4 folder-collapse toggle only hid strips; both the UF8 ChannelEncoder and the UC1 CHANNEL encoder still scrolled past hidden tracks. v0.1.5 plumbs the filtered visible-track list into every track-step navigation path: UF8 ChannelEncoder (bindings ChSelect + Nav-mode SelectRelative), UC1 CHANNEL encoder, and the PendingInput drain branch.
Encoder dispatch action label shortened to "Encoder: dispatch by current mode" (was a wall of nine enumerated modes in the action picker).

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Plug-in name display unified across UF8 colour bar, UC1 central LCD, and the Toggle Plugin UI action: cycling through plug-ins on the focused strip now updates immediately with the cycle target's name, including unmapped (ReaEQ, third-party) and cross-domain plug-ins. The focused-strip cursor wins over the focused-domain Instance fallback so Encoder: cycle FX landing on a non-SSL FX displays correctly. Non-focused strips unaffected.
Toggle Plugin UI is now a true toggle. Press while a window is owned closes that window regardless of where the cursor has moved between presses. Pressing Toggle UI while UF8 Plugin Mode (with GUI) OR SSL Strip Mode (with GUI) is active disengages the mode AND closes the window in one press -- previously needed two presses after track-change refocus.
Surface knob-touches now move the strip's FX cursor (any PluginMap match: SSL Instance, user CS/BC, UF8-only) so the colour bar and an open Toggle UI window both follow what the user is actively touching. Mantra: "was angezeigt wird = was beim Push aufgeht".
UC1 LCD says "REAPER" (renamed from "MAIN") when no plug-in is on the focused track. BC focus stays strict (BC anchor remains narrow scope).
Encoder 2 BC track-scroll now flips focus to BusComp so Toggle UI opens the BC instance on the new anchor track.
UC1 instance carousel no longer flashes the track name before the plug-in name on each detent. Hard-stop edge (CCW past first / CW past last) still shows the current plug-in name in the carousel.
SSL Strip Mode (with GUI) is CS-only -- removed the UF8-only fallback in its GUI drain. UF8 Plugin Mode is the path for UF8-only plug-ins.
Bank Left/Right and Bank-by-1 clamp at trackCount - 8 (not trackCount - 1) so a 3-track project can't be banked off-screen.
Host-keyboard Shift now counts for additive multi-select via successive SEL presses (Settings -> Modes -> Keyboard Options must be on). v0.1.5 only honoured the UF8 hardware Shift modifier here.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
AutoLearn: new matching engine + Preview UI in the FX Learn Editor. Takes a plug-in's parameter list, suggests UC1 slot + UF8 V-Pot bank assignments via two-layer dictionary (SSL seeds + user-map patterns) with three-pass matching (exact / substring / token) and confidence scoring. Preview modal shows every topology slot with editable customLabel, Param dropdown + filter, conflict highlighting; accept / reject individual rows before applying. Pre-flight Setup modal asks domain (CS / BC / UF8-only) + UF8 V-Pot bank + UF8 Strip targets. Strict-keyword guard for Bypass / Pan so "Bypass" no longer steals "Meter Scale" and "Out Trim" no longer steals "Output Pan"; CH-N params route to UF8 strips / channel-positioned V-Pots instead of generic banks.
FX Learn Editor overhaul: editor is the only landing page (no more master-view). Map picker combo + Default / Short / + New / Delete / Export / Import all live in the editor header. Last-edited map persists via ExtState. + New popup adapts: Create + AutoLearn when the FX isn't in the session, Insert + AutoLearn when it is. GR-meter VST3-param picker dropped (runtime uses PreSonus GainReduction_dB host extension now). All modals centred on the parent host window via new centerNextPopupOnDisplay_ helper -- wide popups no longer slam top-left.
Per-slot custom display labels: new customLabel field on user-mapped slots. Right-click any slot in the FX Learn Editor -> Edit display label -> short string that overrides the parameter's default name on UF8 / UC1 scribble strips. Canonical name shows as placeholder. Empty = fall back to parameter name. JSON-persisted as additive field, backward-compatible with v0.1.6 maps.
Per-fader scribble label: new faderLabel field on UserUf8StripBinding. UF8 plug-in mode reads it when the V-Pot bank slot for that strip is unmapped -- lets a fader controlling a custom parameter have its own scribble independent of the V-Pot row.
Shift activates Fine mode: new Settings -> Modes toggle. Keyboard Shift OR UF8 Shift button momentarily engages Fine mode (0.25x step) on every V-Pot and UC1 encoder. Releases on release. Faders unaffected. Works alongside the existing UC1 Fine button toggle -- Shift wins while held.
USB driver uninstall buttons: Settings -> About gains Uninstall buttons next to Install. Windows removes WinUSB driver + signing cert via PowerShell (UAC); Linux removes /etc/udev/rules.d/99-rea-sixty.rules via pkexec. For switching back to SSL 360 temporarily or clean uninstall.
UC1 encoder calibration: CHANNEL ticksPerStep 4->3, BC ticksPerStep 3->2. The encoders fire 3 or 4 (CHANNEL) / 2 or 3 (BC) ticks per physical detent depending on rotation speed; the previous calibration ate the shorter-tick clicks.
Smart Abbreviate now lives in a single TrackName helper shared between UF8 (7-char scribble), UC1 carousels (CS=12, BC=14), and the REC-mode V-Pot label (7-char). Trailing 2+ digit runs are reserved as identity-like, so "MPEQ Main 2 M32" abbreviates to "MPM2M32" instead of "MPEM2M3". Repeated digits no longer collapse ("M33" stays "M33").
Nav Mode UF8 symmetry: UF8 channel-encoder now mirrors UC1 Encoder 2. Rotation moves the drill cursor one step per detent (vs. paging 8) when "UF8 encoder takes over in Nav" is on. Push fires the same plain / shift / long action picker as UC1. New "Keep track colour" radio in the colour-bar source picker -- LCD bar follows the track colour while top-soft-key LEDs keep the marker/region colour. New "Show UF8 Nav overlay" toggle for independent rendering.
Nav LED dedup fix: channel-encoder-mode LEDs (Nav / Nudge / Focus) refresh on per-cell state change, not on encoder-mode change. Previously a binding whose stateOf depended on something other than encoder mode (e.g. marker_overlay_toggle on Nav) never re-triggered the refresh and the LED froze.
Encoder Mode now exits Nav Mode automatically: any user-initiated encoder-mode switch (Nav / Nudge / Mousewheel / Markers / BankBy1 / LastParam / Instance / FxCycle / SelsetCycle) exits Nav Mode in one move. Project-load and setup-bundle paths bypass this so saved state survives.
Palette quantizer fixes: pink (hue ~330 deg, e.g. FF0080) now lands on 0x0B light violet (LCD renders as lilac/pink) instead of red. Magenta (hue ~300 deg, e.g. FB02FF) stays on 0x06 deep violet, so pink and magenta now render as visually distinct cells -- the SEL LEDs already differentiated; the LCD now matches. Dark greys (e.g. 4C4C4C) short-circuit to 0x00 OFF instead of 0x01 light violet, which was making dark grey tracks look "white" because the LCD lights every quantised cell at constant brightness.
UF8 channel-number digit (the tiny digit top-left of each strip's colour bar) and the "CH N" track-name fallback now read IP_TRACKNUMBER -- REAPER's 1-based actual track number, identical to REAPER's track headers and UC1's 7-segment indicator. Folder-collapsed sessions no longer show a confusing visible-slot index that diverges from REAPER's track list.
Pinned tracks (B_TCPPIN, "pin to top of arrange view") now anchor to the leftmost strips on the surface when Surface mirrors TCP, mirroring how REAPER's TCP renders them. Banking only moves the non-pinned strips. New checkbox "Pinned tracks survive banking" (default on, under the TCP/MCP Surface mirrors radio). Sticky auto-disables when >=8 tracks are pinned -- pinned still sort first in the visible list and spill across banks. MCP-mode is unaffected (MCP has no pin concept in REAPER).
REC V-Pot keyboard-shift modifier: Shift+V-Pot for input-channel selection now honours keyboard Shift (gated by Settings -> Modes -> Keyboard Options -> "Use keyboard Shift as modifier"). Previously only the UF8 hardware Shift button worked.
Instance Cycle stale cursor + blank label for plug-in-less tracks: UF8 csType falls back to the focused-Instance label when the raw cursor points at an unmapped FX (stale from prior FxCycle). Tracks with zero plug-ins now render a blank slot on both UF8 and UC1 (was "REAPER" or "MAIN") -- clearer "nothing here" cue.
Appearance -> Spelling radio: flips user-facing strings between "Colour"/"Grey" (British, SSL house style) and "Color"/"Gray" (American). Identifiers in code stay color regardless. Pure decoration.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Per-slot knob travel: every user-learned FX Learn slot gains Min / Max range clamp, encoder-delta sensitivity (0.1x..4x), and a per-slot response curve. Right-click any slot in the FX Learn schematic for inline Min / Max sliders + "Advanced..." -- opens a curve editor with draggable breakpoints + Linear / Log / Exp / Reset presets. Defaults (Min=0, Max=1, sensitivity=1, no curve) make the maths byte-identical to the previous linear path; v0.1.7 maps load unchanged. JSON storage is additive. Customised slots show two radial ticks at the Min / Max angles + a centre dot when a curve is set on the on-screen knob.
Knob travel now works on UC1 too. The UC1 channel-strip / bus-comp knobs and the EXT_FUNCS encoder honour the same per-slot range / curve / sensitivity as the UF8 V-Pots. A UC1 knob and a UF8 V-Pot bound to the same parameter stay in lock-step. Built-in SSL CS/BC slots untouched -- knob travel only kicks in when a user-learned slot is present for the focused plug-in.
UF8 V-Pots in Plugin Mode (user-map) get the same Min / Max / Advanced... controls on right-click as the FX Learn schematic. Range and curve are stored per-binding (faderBank, vpotBank, strip) -- different V-Pots can drive the same parameter with different feels. Fill Sequential copies travel verbatim alongside the existing inverted / vpotMode / colour fields. The LED ring on the LCD V-Pot bar follows the encoder's t-space (inverse-curved) so a tight range no longer compresses the ring into a sliver of its sweep. UF8 faders intentionally exclude knob travel -- absolute-position + motor-feedback creates round-trip races with plug-in quantisation.
V-Pot polarity: new Unipolar / Bipolar toggle per V-Pot binding. Bipolar (opt-in per binding -- default Unipolar) makes Pan-like parameters render centre-out on the LCD ring (mode register 0x08, same as SSL Pan slots) instead of L->R sweep, and the Log / Exp curve presets produce shapes that mirror around 0.5. Push-reset slider shows a non-binding hint with a 0.5 quick-set button when not already at centre. Polarity re-read on every preset click so flipping it in the parent menu takes effect without re-opening the editor.
Curve editor canvas: Linear preset is now a clean 45-degree diagonal regardless of how Min / Max are trimmed. Y-axis normalised within [rangeMin..rangeMax] -- top edge is rangeMax, bottom is rangeMin. Click / drag maps canvas Y back to absolute parameter space so storage semantics are unchanged.
Curve editor is target-driven: the same modal now serves FX Learn slots and UF8 V-Pot bindings, parameterised by a small read + four-setter callback set. Sensitivity row hides when the target doesn't support it.
fx_param_inc / fx_param_dec: two new builtin actions in the Bindings action picker. Step the same FX Learn slot a V-Pot is bound to from a button -- configurable step size + wrap, respects the slot's range / curve / sensitivity. Useful for one-shot "+1 dB" or "next preset value" buttons.
GR meter override: small "GR" button next to AutoLearn in the FX Learn editor opens a compact popup to designate a VST3 parameter as the GR readout, for plug-ins where the PreSonus GainReduction_dB host extension doesn't reach. Flows through to the UC1 BC VU motor calibration tables and the DYN GR LED strip. Defaults to "use host extension" -- opt-in per learned plug-in.
Settings -> About now shows a Version line above Build, sourced from git describe --tags --always --dirty via the existing commit_count.h header generator. On a release tag: v0.1.8. Between tags: v0.1.8-N-g<sha>. Dirty working tree: trailing -dirty.
Bug fixes: - FX Learn schematic knob ticks: the range arc was previously starting at 10:30 and sweeping through 3 o'clock (off-centre). Now a 300-degree sweep from 7 o'clock to 5 o'clock with the dead-zone at the bottom where the physical knob's gap is. - UC1 knobs were silently ignoring user-set range / curve / sensitivity in v0.1.7 -- the data was wired through to UF8 dispatch but UC1Surface was missed. Now resolved.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Knob travel works on stepped params now (UF8 V-Pots Plugin Mode + focused CS/BC, UC1 CS/BC knobs, UC1 EXT_FUNCS). Sensitivity = "Detent speed": 1.0x = 2 detents per step, 2.0x = 1 per detent, 4.0x = 2 steps per detent. Shift = Fine quarters on top. - Stepped params: Min/Max snap to step grid; push reset snaps to nearest step; curve editor swaps to info line when bound param is stepped. - New "Set" button next to Min/Max in the curve editor right-click menu: snaps that range edge to the plug-in's current parameter value. Dial the FX to where you want the bound, click Set. - Curve editor right-click Min/Max rows now align pixel-perfect (4-col table: label / slider / input / Set). - Sensitivity row in curve editor popup: single-row layout (label above, slider + input + 1x reset below). - UC1 Encoder 2: ticksPerStep 2 -> 3, fixes double-stepping on fast turns. - UC1 track delete: focus snaps to the track directly above the deleted one (not project track 1). Carousel + zone 0x02 refresh immediately. - Instance Cycle: focused slotIdx preserved when target instance has the same LinkSlot. No more reset to slot 0 / Bypass on every cycle step. - tickStepped sens floor 0.1 -> 0.001 so Shift-Fine at slider min still slows further. - Curve editor popup 380 -> 390 px height.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Prettyyyyy... Prettyyyyy... Pretty Good! - Folder Mode learns nested folders: long-press SEL spills the full ancestor chain, collapse keeps descendant spill state so re-spilling the top instantly restores the drill-down. - New Temporary Selection Set parallel to the 8 named slots — built-ins temp_selset_add / _remove / _recall / _scroll. Mutually exclusive with the 1..8 slot recall. - UC1 Encoder 1 (CHANNEL) now fully bindable like Encoder 2. Default Plain = new built-in track_scroll (visible-track scroll + select + UC1 focus follow). Shift = instance_cycle. - New built-in bc_track_scroll_select: same scroll as bc_track_scroll but also pulls REAPER selection + UF8 bank to the new BC anchor. Original bc_track_scroll unchanged. - FX Learn user fader label now appears on the UF8 scribble's upper line, not just in the value-line fallback. - Release codenames: extension/version-names.tsv maps each tag to a codename, shown on the About tab below the version line. - Persistence rebuilt: Selection Set slots + Temp set saved into the project RPP via the official projectconfig SDK hook. Old SetProjExtState path was silently dropping writes on some REAPER builds.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Even Prettier - Strip Mode: focused param slot no longer snaps to Bypass when scrolling tracks with a plug-in window open. Chase path now applies the same slot-sticky rule as v0.1.9's Instance Cycle fix — preserves slot when target FX exposes the same LinkSlot, resets only on cross-domain or unmapped slots. - Temp Selection Set now participates in Selection-Set Auto-Mode (Settings -> Modes -> AUTO). Recalling in AUTO mode arms its members to the configured automation mode; deactivating reverts to Trim/Read. Mutual-exclusion handoff slot <-> temp also reverts the outgoing set.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Bizarre Gardening Accident - UC1 gets full REC + RME (TotalReaper) integration on its focused-track surface. Encoder 2 rotation steps preamp gain +/-1 dB; Fine (or keyboard Shift) + rotation cycles the track's hardware input channel. Out of the box: 48V on Enc2 Push, Pad on Cut, Phase Invert on Polarity (all reassignable in Settings -> Modes -> REC). CS readout zone shows live "48V Pd Ph + gain" while in REC mode; brief flash to channel name on input-channel changes. - Fine button is momentary while REC / RecMon is the selection mode (was toggle); doubles as the Shift modifier for the Enc2 input-channel cycle. No more "Fine On / Off" readout flash in REC. - CS-scroll channel-name carousel suppressed entirely in REC + RME so the live preamp readout keeps updating during Encoder 1 channel changes. Carousel timeout elsewhere drops from 3 s to 1 s. - Nav Mode is rebuilt as a per-surface matrix (UF8 + UC1 each pick Regions or Markers independently; UC1 additionally has "Mirror UF8" = v0.1.11 behaviour, default). When one surface is in Regions and the other in Markers, the Markers surface auto-scopes to the Regions surface's currently-selected region — cursor move on one snaps the other to the first marker of the new scope. - UF8 region-press drill is suppressed when UC1 is in an independent Mode (would break the cross-coupling); jump still fires. - Settings -> Modes -> NAV is reorganised as a UF8 / UC1 column matrix. Legacy 4-state "Default view on entry" radio removed (UF8 Mode picker now is both entry default + live state). Push-action picker correctly labelled as shared between UC1 Encoder 2 and the UF8 Channel encoder.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Monday is my favorite time of year - Quick Learn: guided FX mapping that sweeps the project (or a single track) for unmapped plug-ins and walks you through learning each one, instead of opening the editor per plug-in by hand. Project + Track scopes, each as a REAPER action, a bindable native action, and a button in the FX-Learn pane. No-op when there's nothing left to learn. - AutoLearn can now map all of a plug-in's parameters 1:1 onto the UF8 faders (category-sorted), so a plug-in maps onto the surface even with the V-Pot target off. New Setup checkbox, default on when V-Pots are off. - AutoLearn preview: consistent Param dropdown + per-row Learn column across all preview tables. REAPER's injected MIDI-learn params ("MIDI CC 0|0", "MIDI Pitch", ...) are filtered out of the param picker. - UC1 Fine now also applies to UF8 V-Pot rotation. V-Pot push-reset safety net: rotation on a strip is swallowed for 250 ms after a push so a twist-on-press can't bump the parameter back off the value you just reset. - Configurable encoder nudge step (unit + amount) in Settings -> Modes -> Nudge (was a hardcoded 1 s per detent). - Fix: a V-Pot turn could crash REAPER (a self-recursion in the Fine-mode check was lowered to a hard trap and fired on every V-Pot move). Fixed. - Fix: AutoLearn matched Bus-Comp params to the wrong slot (e.g. a plug-in's "Release" landing on the "Input" slot). The generic-naming dictionary no longer leaks Channel-Strip slot indices into the Bus-Comp namespace. - Fix: the UC1 routing diagram now paints the moment you press the Routing button, instead of staying blank until the first encoder turn. - Fix: developer-grouping vendor fallback now resolves for non-SSL maps too. - Fix: V-Pot stale-track-pointer crash guards in the input drain + plug-in lookup; swapped SEL-LED magenta/pink colours corrected. - Fix: Acustica Audio (Acqua) plug-ins are no longer host-polled for gain reduction and their GUIs are never auto-opened, removing the crash path their threading model triggered.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Dancing in the Dark - Fix (Windows): Rea-Sixty no longer changes the process-wide DLL search at load. To find its own bundled libusb / hidapi it used to alter the default search for the whole process, which permanently dropped "search the loading DLL's own folder" for every plug-in. Plug-ins that load helper DLLs from their own folder (Acustica/Acqua: Tiger, Tiger Mix, ...) then couldn't find them and crashed with an access violation on open. Rea-Sixty now pre-loads its own dependencies by full path and leaves the process DLL search untouched. This is the real cause behind the Acustica crash the v0.1.13 gain-reduction guard did not resolve.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: My Blood is too thick for Nevada - New: "Rea-Sixty Input Level" JSFX probe gives the UC1 a true input meter (live even while stopped); drop it anywhere in a track's FX chain - Fix: UC1 I/O meter LEDs now light at their labelled dB (e.g. -18 lights at -18, not -17.9) - Fix: output meter no longer flickers on a steady level at a threshold - Fix: input probe no longer under-reads transients (a -12 dB snare metered -15) - New: FX-Learn "+New" plugin picker grouped by vendor - New: UC1 EXT FUNCS hidden menu (CS mode) is now user-curatable per plug-in; SSL plug-ins keep their fixed list

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Boy, that escalated quickly! - New: knob "feel" presets — save a knob's range/curve/sensitivity/polarity/push-reset into 5 named global slots and apply across knobs + V-Pots - New: in-app user manual at Settings -> Manual - Fix: UC1 IN button now maps to Bypass (was the confusing "Input Trim"); FX-Learn popup no longer errors or doubles its rows - Fix: FX-Learn Inverted now works on param-toggle buttons (EQ In, Dyn In, Polarity, ...) - Fix: custom display labels now stick on UC1 buttons, like knobs - New: POL button can be FX-Learned to a plug-in param ("Reaper Track Polarity" checkbox, default on) - Fix: UC1 I/O meter no longer goes dark when the Bus Compressor is bypassed - Fix: re-binding a slot clears its now-stale custom label - Fix: AutoLearn no longer lists the dead SSL "Quick 1-6" slots

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Off on the Charabanc! - New: per-meter peak fall rate (Settings -> Device -> Metering); all meters peak-hold, UC1 input now decays in lock-step with output (Peak/VU/RMS selector removed) - Fix: output meter under-read — a -6 dB signal used to light only to -9 - New: UC1 Out Gain knob can flip to drive REAPER track volume instead of the SSL Fader Level param (Hardware Modes builtin + REAPER action); works even with no channel strip on the track - Fix: FX-Learn parameter search is now case-insensitive ("out" finds "Output Gain") - Fix: FX-Learn dropdowns no longer shrink as the search narrows the list - Fix: an inverted EQ-IN / DYN-IN button no longer dims the knob-ring cascade in reverse

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: That's not a knife... that's a knife! - New: Shift + channel encoder = range-select across adjacent tracks, REAPER Shift+Arrow style — bindable encoder action "Encoder: extend track selection" (Cycle Actions); no default binding, Shift stays Instance-Cycle - Change: the mixer now scrolls to the selected track only when it is off-screen (minimal, like a mouse click) instead of yanking it to the leftmost strip on every UF8/UC1 selection

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Anchors Aweigh - Fix: UF8 faders in Touch automation no longer nudge a track to ~-0.5 dB and seed the new envelope there on tracks with no volume automation — touches now anchor to the motor's true position and write only relative motion; 0 dB lands exactly on 0 dB - New: UC1 buttons bound to a multi-option plug-in param (e.g. SPL Iron's SC EQ, 6 settings) step through every option and wrap, instead of jumping first to last

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Behave! - New: UC1 button push-cycle editor in FX Learn — pick exactly which options a discrete button (EQ Type, HF/LF Bell, Comp Fast Attack, Peak, Expand, Gate Attack) steps through; untick to exclude, options stay visible and in place - New: drag the handle to reorder the cycle - New: build a multi-parameter macro on an unmapped button via "+ Add step" — one button can walk several plug-in params (e.g. an SSL concept split across separate toggles on a third-party plug-in) - Tick all options in natural order again and the button reverts to "cycle all"; built-in SSL plug-ins are unchanged

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Stayin' Alive - Fix: multiple selected faders stay in sync — moving one no longer collapses the others onto its level; they move relative and keep their offsets - Fix: a fader you briefly touched now re-engages and follows REAPER again — external volume changes (routing dialog, automation, ganged moves) reach it instead of being ignored until you nudge it - Fix: Touch-mode volume envelopes seed at the value where you grabbed the fader, not a slightly-later moved value - Fix: uncoloured markers show REAPER's marker colour on the UF8 instead of grey

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: It's Suntory Time - Fix: marquee zoom no longer snaps the arrange view back to the selected track — view-follow now fires only on hardware selection (UF8/UC1 SEL, encoder, param-follow), not on mouse/marquee/actions

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: That's all he said? - Fix: UC1 SSL CS EQ-gain knobs turn at the same rate as Freq/Q (were much finer); 0-dB centre still snaps reliably - Fix: UF8 V-pots no longer lag or drop fast spins — removed a debug log that wrote to disk on every USB packet, plus a livelier per-detent step

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Scroll to Infinity and Beyond - New: Cross-track FX / Instance scroll — encoder walks all FX on a track, then crosses to the next track (SSL 360°-native); available as Encoder Modes and as direct-bindable actions - New: Right-click a control in the UF8/UC1 schematic → reset just that one binding to factory default - Fix: Vertical zoom in / out actions were inverted

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Catch the Game Last Night? - New: Master track on the surfaces — show Master as Track 0 on UC1, UC1 Out-Gain drives the Master fader, Bus Compressor on the Master shows in the BC carousel, and pin the Master to UF8 Strip 1 / 8 (Replace strip or Shift banking) - New: Active CS / BC marker in REAPER's TCP/MCP Inserts list (opt-in, Settings → Device) — see at a glance which plug-in the surface is driving - New: Encoder Mode → FX Move (in chain) + fx_move action to shuffle the active FX up / down in the focused track's chain - New: Combine GR across plug-ins — optionally sum every compressor's gain reduction; separate UF8 / UC1 toggles - Polish: Device pane tidied, searchable combo-popup width fix, "Plug-in" spelt consistently throughout

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Pineapple Express - New: Inserts marker is now a non-destructive on-screen overlay (JS_Composite) on REAPER's Mixer Inserts list — no FX rename, no dirty project; replaces the old renamed_name marker - New: Overlay is design-able — CS / BC colour, fill + border opacity, row height + top offset (Settings → Device → Inserts) - New: Optional dockable focused-track panel — shows the focused track's CS, the surface's BC (any track), and the last-changed parameter by its Rea-Sixty name; adjustable font, right-click to dock / undock - New: Both the overlay and the docker are independent persistent toggles that come back automatically when REAPER opens; companion is baked into the extension with a Start/Stop button in Settings - New: "None (disabled)" option in the Bindings action editor to explicitly unbind a slot - Fix: overlay rescans are event-driven now (no typing lag)

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Randy - I AM the Liquor! - New: Learn-HUD — dockable window listing the focused plug-in's UC1 control → parameter map; CS / BC tabs follow focus, NORM / OPT / CTRL layer badge, click-a-row + wiggle to learn. Toggle via the learn_hud_toggle built-in or the "Rea-Sixty: Toggle Learn-HUD" action (no Settings checkbox) - New: Learn-HUD right-click — text size + text colour (CS/BC or white); window size persists globally (default 500x500) - New: FX-Learn modifier layers (Normal / Option / Control) — a UC1 control carries three overlays (own param, invert, knob-travel, Display label); edit via the editor's layer tabs, use by holding Option / Control (enable in Settings → Device → Keyboard Options) - New: Focused-track panel "Use track colour" — draws the track name in its REAPER colour - Change: Inserts overlay now defaults to a clean outline — CS yellow, BC red, no fill - Fix: per-layer custom Display labels show correctly on the UC1 LCD, FX-Learn editor, Learn-HUD and focused-track panel — no more snap-back to the default name after a press / turn / release - Fix: modifier-layer mappings no longer lost when switching the FX-Learn edit domain (slot cache now stores overlays) - Fix: British / American spelling setting honoured in the focused-track panel menu

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: I like them teeny, and toasty. - New: Learn-HUD + focused-track panel rebuilt on ReaImGui — real windows, drag/dock anywhere (arrange, TCP, second monitor); the legacy gfx versions are retired - New: Learn-HUD List + hardware Mockup views; right-click a control → Learn / Invert / Rename / Unbind (acts on the active modifier layer; built-in SSL maps stay factory-fixed) - New: Shift+360 toggles the Learn-HUD (default binding, UF8 + UC1 360 button) - Change: Learn-HUD modifier layers show only the controls you actually overlaid on that layer (inherited ones read as unmapped); CS / BC never cross domains; the LCD name follows the focused domain - New: Focused-track panel — track name before/after the CS/BC tag, short FX names (SSL → CS2 / BC2), "Load on startup" - Change: FX-Learn UC1/UF8 mockups + EXT FUNCS grid scaled to 730px; right-click menus honour the Appearance font size - Fix (Windows): export "save dialog unavailable" now uses the native Save dialog; AltGr engages the FX-Learn Option layer

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Impossible to walk in this muck. No footing at all. - New: UF8 device tab in the Learn-HUD — interactive strip-grid (8 strips × V-Pot / Fader / Solo / Cut / Sel), bank-aware (Top-Soft-Keys pick the V-Pot bank); click a bank to switch it - New: UF8 Parameter List — open the drawer, type to filter, pick a parameter, click a cell to bind it (no wiggle); bound params show a green dot - New: UF8 Touch-to-Learn — arm a cell by moving its control on the hardware (touch a fader, turn a V-Pot, press Solo/Cut/Sel), then wiggle a plug-in parameter to bind - New: map an unmapped plug-in straight from the HUD (the first bind bootstraps a UF8-only map); right-click a cell for Invert / Fill sequential / Unbind / V-Pot value-toggle mode - New: UF8 hardware-mockup view (toggle List ↔ Mockup), faithful to the FX-Learn UF8 face; all learn / colour / bank interactions work in both views - New: V-Pot bank colours — right-click a bank → 10-swatch SSL palette sets its Top-Soft-Key LED colour; "Bar colour (all)" paints the active bank's display colour bars - New: UC1 Control+Option FX-Learn layer — a fourth modifier overlay, so one knob can carry up to four mappings - New: 10 knob feel-preset slots (was 5) - Fix: UC1 two-knob "fight for priority" — the input parser now walks every frame in a USB transfer; modifier-layer knob travel + focused readout fall back correctly - Fix: Esc cancels a HUD learn / assign even when the HUD isn't focused; the held modifier layer is latched at context-menu open; Esc also closes the FX-Learn curve editor popup - Fix: console spam gone (full ReaImGui header signature-drift audit)

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: Exsqueeze me? Baking powder? - New: global per-surface V-Pot / encoder speed + Fine factor (Settings → Device) — tune UF8 and UC1 independently - New: tunable 0 dB virtual notch on UF8 V-Pots AND UC1 knobs (EQ gains / trims / fader level) — snaps reliably to 0 dB on approach; settings for notch zone, fine step near 0, and a soft-detent "hold" so an endless encoder can't overshoot - New: pan honours the same V-Pot speed / Fine scaling - Fix: Learn-HUD "End() too many times" crash (hardware-layout tab / collapsed HUD); geometry-section parse hardened - Fix: stale pre-ReaImGui companion scripts removed on load, so an old Action can no longer launch the broken gfx HUD

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: 60% of the time, it works every time. - Fix: FX-Learn params on JSFX plug-ins no longer slam to an extreme — driven as continuous with a sub-linear accel curve; UF8 V-Pots and UC1 encoders now feel identical on the same param - Fix: Fine mode (Shift) keeps working on coarse JSFX sliders — sub-step moves accumulate until the value advances - New: FX Learn → Advanced sensitivity goes down to 0.01 (typeable value box); Device speed minimum lowered to 0.10 - Fix: UC1 CHANNEL-encoder scroll no longer leaves the 7-seg / LCD counting up after a fast flick — display jumps straight to the landed track - New: UF8 bank-scroll stride (Settings → Bindings → UF8) — scroll past the surface edge by 8 (next bank) or by 1 channel

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: 60.01% of the time, it works every time. - New: Device V-Pot / encoder speed minimum lowered from 0.10 to 0.01 (Settings → Device) for ultra-slow, ultra-fine control - Fix: a typed 0.01 device speed is no longer clamped back to 0.10 internally or lost on restart — the lower bound now applies consistently in the UI field, the setter and the persisted setting

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: There's always money in the banana-stand. - New: Channel-Strip Switch — 8 favourite Channel Strips swap in place, carrying values across by engineering value + meaning (favourites must be mapped) - New: Touch-to-Learn — touch a control and wiggle a parameter to bind it on the fly, without opening Settings - New: Rotary Step cycle — put a plug-in's button/enum options on a V-Pot or UC1 knob (turn to scrub, press to step) - New: Parameter Groups mirror an unmapped, identical plug-in 1:1 across group members — no mapping needed - New: Focus Set — pin the focused track (or a chosen set) to the left of the surface - New: Solo/Mute modifier modes — hold a keyboard modifier + Solo/Cut for REAPER's solo/mute button modes (UF8 + UC1) - New: V-Pot pan now records track-pan automation in Touch and holds - New: empty UF8 channels park the fader fully down - New: user-definable SSL CS/BC free soft-key slots + coherent factory banks - New: in-app manual is searchable and rewritten in plain, user-facing language - Fix: JSFX continuous knobs resolve finely; binary on/off knob flips per detent; Learn-HUD nil-crash; CS-Switch value-transfer robustness; Windows build

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: - Codename: We can't stop here, this is bat country. - New: Send/Receive surface views follow REAPER 7.75 — empty send slots show as gaps in the right place, reordered sends keep their order, and a send after an empty slot no longer disappears - New: hardware outputs appear in the Send view alongside track sends (same order as REAPER's mixer send list), named by output channel, each with its own fader/pan - Fix: soloing a send now mutes every other track send AND hardware output across the whole list (was stopping at the first gap); send mute LEDs show on all routed strips - New: empty FX-chain slots (REAPER 7.75) handled by the inserts overlay, Encoder FX-Move, and Channel-Strip Switch - New: inserts overlay marks the selected FX, and follows the mixer when hidden/shown or fullscreen - New: sensitivity is shown in the Learn-HUD and FX-Learn hover tooltips - Fix: Fill Sequential carries every per-control property (steps, mode, feel, label); Windows modifier feed + build

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Initial ReaPack release

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Use REAPERAPI_MINIMAL so the plugin loads on REAPER older than the SDK pin Static-link the MSVC runtime on Windows (no VC++ Redistributable required) Pin macOS deployment target to 11.0 (Big Sur) for arm64 + older Intel coverage Fix stereo monitoring: skip balpan on stereo inputs, enforce B_MAINSEND every tick

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Add Toggle 2-Way Control — TotalMix fader/balpan moves now drive the matching REAPER track volume/pan (and direct send vol/pan) when enabled alongside the Routing Mirror. Echo-suppression keeps the loop stable. Add Toggle Auto-Talkback on Stop — drives /controlroom/talkback from REAPER's transport: stop/pause opens talkback, play/record closes it. Toggling on while stopped opens immediately; toggling off closes it. Replace single-slot snapshot save/load with one action per TotalMix snapshot slot (Save/Load TotalMix Snapshot Slot 1…8) so each slot can have its own keybinding. Remove Send Test Mute Input 1 (superseded by Toggle OSC Dump for sanity checking)

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Fix 2-Way Control snapping REAPER faders to -inf when Routing Mirror is toggled on. /sendall was firing before the REAPER→TotalMix push completed, so the empty TotalMix state came back and 2-Way wrote it into REAPER. Push now happens first; a brief priming window after push absorbs /sendall echoes without disturbing track state.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
2-way mirror /input/<n>/{48v,pad,phase,gain} into track P_EXT (P_EXT:totalreaper_48v / pad / phase / gain) so any control surface or ReaScript watching the cache reflects direct changes the user makes in TotalMix's UI within one tick, not just after a REAPER-side action. Always-on regardless of 2-Way Control because preamp readbacks are metadata, not routing state.
DumpOsc toggle confirmation now logs to console in release builds — debugLog() was a no-op when NDEBUG is defined, so turning the dump on or off gave no visible feedback in shipped binaries.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Routing mirror: the source track's REAPER pan is now composed into every walked HW-routed bus, not just the main monitor. Headphone cues and other downstream HW outs follow the REAPER pan instead of staying centred.
Routing mirror: clear the per-bus send-routing cache when a track's I_RECINPUT is reassigned. Without the wipe, the new input's matrix cells on every walked bus stayed at -inf until something else perturbed the state — phones now follow input-channel changes immediately, no rec-arm toggle required.
README: document the "Receive to hidden channels" requirement in TotalMix's OSC Details settings. Without it TotalMix silently drops `/mix/in/<n>/<bus>/fader` writes for any channel not in the current layout — the routing mirror appears completely dead even though TotalReaper is sending correctly.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Routing mirror: only one REAPER track per hardware input now drives the TotalMix matrix cells (the first rec-armed + monitoring track, falling back to the first monitor-only track). Previously every monitoring track that shared an input pushed its own gain values, producing visible fader jitter during slow send moves and breaking mute semantics: send-mute and channel-mute didn't reach TotalMix because other tracks' non-∞ writes overwrote the -∞ close-out within the same Run() tick.
Routing mirror: channel-mute (REAPER track B_MUTE) now drives the owned matrix cells to -∞ on every walked bus, matching the behaviour of monitor-off.
Routing mirror: tick-level TX dedupe — each Run() tick now emits at most one /mix/in/<hwIdx>/<bus>/fader and /balpan per cell. Fixes rapid-fire 4-5 writes per cell per tick that landed during fader moves with multiple tracks on the same input.
Toggle OSC Dump: now also logs outgoing (TX) messages, not just incoming (RX). Used to surface the duplicate-push pattern that motivated the dedupe and primary-owner fix.
Routing mirror: the source track's REAPER pan is now composed into every walked HW-routed bus, not just the main monitor. Headphone cues and other downstream HW outs follow the REAPER pan instead of staying centred.
Routing mirror: clear the per-bus send-routing cache when a track's I_RECINPUT is reassigned. Without the wipe, the new input's matrix cells on every walked bus stayed at -inf until something else perturbed the state — phones now follow input-channel changes immediately, no rec-arm toggle required.
README: document the "Receive to hidden channels" requirement in TotalMix's OSC Details settings. Without it TotalMix silently drops `/mix/in/<n>/<bus>/fader` writes for any channel not in the current layout — the routing mirror appears completely dead even though TotalReaper is sending correctly.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
First Windows release (reaper_totalreaper.dll) alongside macOS arm64 / x86_64.
Fixed: direct hardware-output sends are now mirrored. A track routed straight to a hardware output (e.g. the RME phones channels) now follows REAPER — previously only track → bus-track → hardware chains were picked up, so headphone aux levels didn't react. Works forward and via 2-Way Control.
New: Settings window — action "TotalReaper: Open Settings Window" opens a panel for OSC ports (configurable, applied live) and toggles for Routing Mirror / 2-Way Control / Auto-Talkback / Stereo-Pair Link, kept in sync with the matching actions and toolbar icons. Requires ReaImGui (install via ReaPack → Browse packages); if it's missing the action just says so and everything else keeps working.
New: Stereo-pair linking — optionally link REAPER stereo inputs as TotalMix stereo pairs; unlinks automatically when you switch back to mono and re-centers the freed partner channel. Pan/balance and stereo width round-trip both directions (REAPER ↔ TotalMix) with echo suppression so TotalMix's hard-L/R reset on link changes doesn't fight your settings.
